svg.text: Coupling checks the test expects (handbook 6.4.1 / skills supplement)

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
text.tspan: 1. Trailer is at the right height -- fifth wheel must contact the apron and lift the trailer slightly. Too high can miss the kingpin or hook the head.
2. Locking jaws closed around the shank; locking lever in the lock position. Look into the fifth wheel if you can.
3. No space between the upper fifth wheel (apron) and the lower fifth wheel. You should not see light / a gap.
4. Tug test (try to pull forward gently in low gear) before retracting the landing gear. Then raise landing gear fully.
5. Connect and test air lines and the electrical cord; open the supply-line valve; listen for leaks; charge trailer air; check trailer brakes.
